```plato

    // One corner's contribution in three dimensions; zero outside its radius.
    SimplexCorner3D(seed: Integer, i: Integer, j: Integer, k: Integer, dx: Number, dy: Number, dz: Number): Number {
        var t = 0.6 - dx * dx - dy * dy - dz * dz;
        var falloff = t * t * t * t;
        return t < 0.0 ? 0.0 : falloff * LatticeGradient3D(seed, i, j, k).Dot((dx, dy, dz));
    }
```
